readerCopy.body: Pulling away as a connection starts to feel good can recreate the distance an older rejection taught everyone to expect. When Venus squares Chiron, connection and sensitivity create friction, making unanswered messages, vague plans, small tests, or sudden coolness act out the anticipated ending before the current relationship has produced it. The instinct can protect against surprise while changing the bond being evaluated. The present connection needs enough room to establish its own pattern before the old one is treated as inevitable.
